## Plugin reference

- Description: Guided setup-flow primitive: <Steps> ordered container auto-numbering <Step> items (upcoming/active/done states, dimmed-and-inert future steps, check-on-done, connecting rail), plus StepLink (open-external), StepDone (success line), StepNote (muted hint) and StepCommand (copyable command row) affordances.
